args.title: Fix Malformed row error on Windows line endings in parser.ts
args.body:
File: src/ingest/parser.ts

In parseStatement, filter out or ignore empty lines or carriage returns at the end of the text so that trailing blank lines with \r\n do not cause a 'Malformed row' error.

label: bug
file: src/ingest/parser.ts
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

In src/ingest/parser.ts, parseStatement splits the text by '\n' and pops a trailing empty line if lines[lines.length - 1] === '', but does not handle lines that contain a carriage return '\r' (i.e. '\r\n') where the last line becomes '\r', causing it not to be popped and failing with a Malformed row error.
In src/ingest/parser.ts, filter out empty lines (or lines containing only whitespace/carriage returns) or skip them before parsing data rows so that trailing blank lines do not cause a 'Malformed row' error.
